artifact_tests.scope: Newline records only; a bounded 8 MiB-character buffer is required. No custom separators.
Empty lines are unnumbered. Logical-page escape sequences are treated as literal text.
One full-field sort key; numeric mode requires finite decimal/scientific values. No locale, random or human-size sorting. Bounded 8 MiB-character row buffer.
As upstream, strips surrounding row whitespace before sorting fields.
Whole line or one selected field; stable representative, bounded 8 MiB-character buffer. Header lines pass unchanged.
Only consecutive duplicates are grouped; no arbitrary field skipping or blank-delimited grouping.
Literal nonempty separator; at most 10000 output rows and 16 MiB estimated characters per input row. Fixes upstream last-column newline handling.
Literal matching only: no regular expressions, shell commands, sed programs or replacement backreferences. Case-insensitive matching is locale-independent. Missing selected columns fail.
Literal matching only: no regular expressions, shell commands, sed programs or replacement backreferences. Case-insensitive matching is locale-independent. Missing selected columns fail.
Literal matching only: no regular expressions, shell commands, sed programs or replacement backreferences. Case-insensitive matching is locale-independent. Missing selected columns fail.
Literal text search; no regex, context-line expansion or HTML output.
Unique header names and requested names are required. Ragged rows and unknown headers fail.
Existing data lines are normalized to LF; this avoids concatenating a footer onto an unterminated final row.
One explicit repetition group, bounded 16 MiB output expansion; input is drained, not used to infer repetitions.
Tab-delimited UTF-8; optional leading-character stripping on first header field. Retains source column order. Unknown requested headers fail.
Zero sorts every column; otherwise a one-based column stays first. Headers must be unique.
The input label is explicit configuration; no local path or filename is required.
Explicit character widths only; no automatic boundary detection, FORTRAN descriptors, reports or encoding conversion. Long rows or unpadded short rows fail.
A/C/G/T primer followed only by 0..3; wrapped sequence lines accepted. Buffers at most one 8 MiB-character sequence.

Select mate 1 or 2; validates four-line FASTQ, optional matching + title, equal sequence/quality lengths and even sequence length. No silent truncation. An empty + title remains empty so emitted FASTQ remains valid.

One-based pileup to zero-based half-open intervals. Configurable columns cover six-column, legacy ten-column and custom rows. Active interval limited to 8 MiB bases; blank lines are skipped rather than terminating all input.
Rows with more than two alleles are skipped. Homozygous second allele is N or the configured reference column; extra input columns are retained.

Zero selects all samples; otherwise use a one-based VCF column >=10. Only single-base A/C/G/T SNPs with PASS or missing FILTER are converted. GT position, haploidy, phased calls and all allele indices are handled; missing alleles ignored.
FASTA input/output only; DNA or RNA IUPAC symbols, case preserved, invalid characters rejected. One sequence buffered up to 8 MiB characters.

Standard code table 1, FASTA only. Ambiguous complete codons emit X; terminal partial codons fail. CDS requires ATG start, terminal stop and no internal stop; final stop omitted. Alternate genetic codes are not advertised.
Input lengths must be multiples of three. Only A/C/G/T codons are accepted; output is deterministic lexicographic codon/count TSV, including zero counts.
FASTA input. GC denominator includes ambiguous symbols; zero-length records use GC fraction zero. Output CG% is the upstream fraction, not a percentage.

Uses reverse complement for reverse-strand search, correcting the upstream complement-only bug. Overlapping hits are consistently included. Maximum one million candidate comparisons per record times pattern length is bounded to 64 million.

Statistics TSV output only, no separate gap BED. N-runs split contigs; internal N-runs count as gaps. Uses standard N50 threshold >= half, correcting upstream strict-greater edge. At most 100000 sequences/contigs and one 8 MiB-character record.

Input has an odd number of tab-separated windows with literal indel in the middle. Motifs are literal case-insensitive DNA strings configured by name=sequence or sequence. Output is row-major then motif order to stream without replaying input; upstream uses motif-major order. Regex motifs are not supported.
